title: Transcription profiling of human meningiomas and schwannomas to establish expression patterns of 96 cancer related genes (meningioma subset)

publications.title: Meningiomas and schwannomas: molecular subgroup classification found by expression arrays.

institution: Unidad de Investigacion, Hospital Universitario La Paz, Madrid
platform: Custom low-density cDNA microarray, 96 cancer-related genes (SuperArray/GEArray Q Series; ArrayExpress array design A-MEXP-1126)
age_distribution: Not reported (only DevelopmentalStage='adult' recorded per-sample, no numeric age)
processed_data_format: Tab-delimited derived array data matrix file (E-MTAB-15-processed-data-1598451480.txt, ~231KB uncompressed, one combined matrix covering all 71 hybridizations across the full 68-sample cohort)
needs_manual_review_reason: SCOPE NARROWED TO MENINGIOMA SUBSET, and DATA FILES CONFIRMED MISSING despite rich sample-level metadata. Never previously fetched; identified only as a plausible candidate in this project's first search session (2026-07-10) and independently verified fresh this session via the live BioStudies API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/api/v1/studies/E-MTAB-15). This is a native ArrayExpress submission (no GEO mirror), release date 2008-09-01, 68 total samples: 42 meningiomas (this record), 23 vestibular schwannomas, and 3 normal cerebral meninges controls, confirmed via BioStudies' own live per-sample Experimental Factors and Source Characteristics tables (DISEASE_STATE/TUMOR_GRADE/Sex breakdown, cross-tabulated: 32 WHO grade I + 4 WHO grade I recurrent + 6 WHO grade II meningioma = 42; 14 male + 9 female schwannoma = 23; 1 female + 2 male normal = 3). The schwannoma arm is excluded from this record's counts as a genuinely different tumor entity, consistent with this project's mixed-cohort scope precedent. grade_1=36 combines the 32 primary + 4 recurrent WHO grade I samples (both are grade I, differing only by recurrence status, which is instead captured in treatment_timepoint_status); grade_3 left null since no grade III meningioma is present or excluded with certainty from the available factor breakdown. patient_count is deliberately left 'Not reported' because the 4 recurrent-tumor samples could plausibly represent the same underlying patients as 4 of the 32 primary samples (i.e. a later recurrence biopsy from an already-counted patient) rather than 4 additional distinct individuals; the per-sample 'Individual' field (values like M18, M40, M01) exists but was not exhaustively cross-referenced across all 68 rows in this pass, so 42 distinct patients cannot be confirmed. Publication match: an author/lab-based PubMed search for 'Martinez-Glez meningioma schwannoma expression' returned 4 candidates; PMID 19148485 (Martinez-Glez et al., Int J Oncol 2009) was confirmed as the exact match by its abstract text, which states verbatim '23 schwannomas, 42 meningiomas and 3 normal cerebral meninges' analyzed by 'low density cDNA microarrays... 96 cancer-related genes', an exact match to this accession's title and sample counts; DOI (10.3892/ijo_00000174) obtained via a CrossRef bibliographic-title search since PubMed's own esummary did not carry it. CRITICAL DATA-AVAILABILITY FINDING (SUPERSEDED, see FACT-CHECK UPDATE below): a prior pass claimed the SDRF's referenced 'Derived Array Data Matrix File' returned HTTP 404 via the BioStudies FIRE mirror and concluded no processed data existed. tags.large_cohort left false pending centralized quartile recomputation. FACT-CHECK UPDATE 2026-07-11: this prior finding was WRONG and has been corrected. Independently re-verified by fetching the SDRF's actual named FTP path directly (https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/microarray/data/experiment/MTAB/E-MTAB-15/E-MTAB-15.processed.1.zip, the classic ArrayExpress FTP location referenced in the SDRF's 'Comment [Derived ArrayExpress FTP file]' column, distinct from the BioStudies FIRE mirror path that 404'd): this returns HTTP 200 and downloads a genuine, valid 102KB zip archive containing E-MTAB-15-processed-data-1598451480.txt (231KB uncompressed), a real tab-delimited derived expression data matrix, confirmed by direct unzip and inspection, not merely a redirect or error page. processed_data_available corrected from false to true; access_blocked_metadata_incomplete corrected from true to false. raw_data_available remains false since the SDRF names only a single derived/processed matrix file per sample with no separate raw-signal/CEL-equivalent file column. Separately, this same re-check re-parsed the SDRF directly (71 total rows: 42 meningioma + 23 schwannoma + 6 normal-tissue rows) and confirmed the 'normal' disease-state rows collapse to only 3 unique Source Name values (each hybridized in duplicate, 2 rows per sample), so the previously reported normal_control_tissue.count=3 and total-cohort-of-68-unique-samples figure are both independently reconfirmed correct, no change needed there.
